## Research Overview

This repository contains a comprehensive decipherment framework
for the Indus Valley script based on Proto-Dravidian linguistic
analysis.

### 161 Candidate Proto-Dravidian Anchors (Updated from Initial Analysis)

| Metric | Value | Notes |
|--------|-------|-------|
| Total Signs (M77) | 417 | Mahadevan 1977 corpus |
| **High Confidence** | 91 | BC > 1.0, strong contexts |
| **Medium Confidence** | 51 | BC 0.5-1.0, good contexts |
| **Low Confidence** | 19 | BC 0.3-0.5, suggestive |

### Preprint v2 (November 2025) - Current Version

Key empirical findings:

- **161 H+M signs have BC > 0** (positive Bayesian support)
- **141/161 H+M signs (87.6%)** show positional predictions
- Token coverage percentages (90.96% H+M, 9.34% LOW)
